name: 07 - Instant alerts: matching watch arrived (every 15 min)

parameters.query:
SELECT id
FROM watches
WHERE NOT alerts_sent
  AND listings_done
  AND status = 'in_stock'
  AND auth_status IN ('ai_checked', 'watchmaker_verified');

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.id)
       w.id AS watch_id, w.brand, w.model, w.reference, w.year, w.condition, w.box_papers, w.ask_usd,
       c.id AS customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.language,
       COALESCE(l.title, en.title)             AS listing_title,
       COALESCE(l.description, en.description) AS listing_description,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM watches w
JOIN customer_interests ci
  ON lower(ci.brand) = lower(w.brand)
 AND (ci.reference IS NULL OR lower(ci.reference) = lower(w.reference))
 AND (ci.max_budget_usd IS NULL OR w.ask_usd <= ci.max_budget_usd)
JOIN customers c ON c.id = ci.customer_id AND c.marketing_opt_in
LEFT JOIN listings l  ON l.watch_id = w.id AND l.language = c.language
LEFT JOIN listings en ON en.watch_id = w.id AND en.language = 'en'
WHERE w.id = $1::INT
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_log m
                  WHERE m.customer_id = c.id AND m.watch_id = w.id)
ORDER BY c.id;

INSERT INTO messages_log (customer_id, campaign, watch_id, subject)
VALUES ($1::INT, 'match_alert', $2::INT, $3);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build alert email').item.json.customer_id, $('Build alert email').item.json.watch_id, $('Build alert email').item.json.subject] }}

parameters.query:
-- runs after the emails above, so a failed run is retried next time
UPDATE watches SET alerts_sent = TRUE WHERE id = $1::INT;

parameters.content:
## Instant match alerts
When a checked watch gets its listings, every opted-in customer whose interests match (brand, optional reference, budget) gets an email in their language. Each customer gets each watch only once (`messages_log`).
